daily.title: New wave of 'hoax' bomb threats hits passenger flights across Europe

daily.title: Union pushes for mandatory sentences after alleged assault on Mount Isa police

daily.title: Woman alleged to have stalked Greens senator appears in court

daily.title: 'Completely dead': How Trump himself 'killed' the MAGA movement

daily.title: WA farmers say reported canola crop failures could cost millions
daily.summary: Farmers across Australia's largest canola-producing region consider legal action over reported failures of multiple strains of canola.

daily.title: Pilot died while trying to avoid power pole, final report finds

daily.title: IVF, abortion and more set to cease at Newcastle private hospitals

daily.title: It was a 90s anthem that made millions from a 'stolen' sweet lullaby

daily.title: Distance isn't making anyone fonder of Albanese after interest rate rise
